examples.chinese: 他找你多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎo nǐ duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much change did he give you?

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 這個蛋糕跟這瓶果汁一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn zhè píng guǒzhī yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do this cake and this bottle of juice cost?

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子飯吃得太少了，你有什麼好辦法？
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi fàn chī de tài shǎo le, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
examples.english: This child eats too little food; do you have any good method?

examples.chinese: 我的母親常對我說：「你要多看書，少玩手機。」
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn cháng duì wǒ shuō: “Nǐ yào duō kàn shū, shǎo wán shǒujī.”
examples.english: My mother often says to me: 'You should read more books and play less on your phone.'

examples.chinese: 請你先算一算，然後告訴我這裡一共有多少人。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiān suàn yi suàn, ránhòu gàosu wǒ zhèlǐ yígòng yǒu duōshao rén.
examples.english: Please calculate first, then tell me how many people there are here in total.

examples.chinese: 你知道現在世界上有多少人嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xiànzài shìjiè shàng yǒu duōshao rén ma?
examples.english: Do you know how many people there are in the world now?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank.

examples.chinese: 李太太擔心孩子因為吃得太少，長不高，你有什麼好主意？
examples.pinyin: Lǐ tàitai dānxīn háizi yīnwèi chī de tài shǎo, zhǎng bù gāo, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo zhǔyì?
examples.english: Mrs. Li is worried that her child won't grow tall because he eats too little. Do you have any good ideas?

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 台灣的周圍都是海，還有不少美麗的海灘。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhōuwéi dōu shì hǎi, hái yǒu bùshǎo měilì de hǎitān.
examples.english: Taiwan is surrounded by sea, and there are also many beautiful beaches.

examples.chinese: 許多青少年為了考上好學校，不得不犧牲假日去補習。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qīngshàonián wèile kǎo shàng hǎo xuéxiào, bùdébù xīshēng jiàrì qù bǔxí.
examples.english: Many teenagers, in order to get into a good school, have no choice but to sacrifice their holidays to go to cram school.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà, bùshǎo lǎo fángwū yǐjīng biànchéng xīn dàlóu le.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 剛進公司的員工對環境比較陌生，對工作內容也不熟悉，多多少少需要協助。
examples.pinyin: Gāng jìn gōngsī de yuángōng duì huánjìng bǐjiào mòshēng, duì gōngzuò nèiróng yě bù shúxī, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào xiézhù.
examples.english: Employees who have just joined the company are relatively unfamiliar with the environment and are also not familiar with the work content, so they more or less need assistance.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
examples.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.
examples.english: Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph.

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

examples.chinese: 這座古老的城市因為公共設備太舊，購物也不方便，不少人都搬走了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì yīnwèi gōnggòng shèbèi tài jiù, gòuwù yě bù fāngbiàn, bùshǎo rén dōu bān zǒu le.
examples.english: Because this ancient city's public facilities are too old and shopping is also inconvenient, quite a few people have moved away.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

items.wordHook: a 小(small) child pinches a grain of rice → 少(little).

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 我剛去工作的時候，常常需要同事的幫助。幫助別人讓我覺得很快樂！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qù gōngzuò de shíhou, chángcháng xūyào tóngshì de bāngzhù. Bāngzhù biérén ràng wǒ juéde hěn kuàilè!
examples.english: When I first started working, I often needed my colleagues' help. Helping others makes me feel very happy!

examples.chinese: 同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 我很餓，同事把他的薯條分一半給我，讓我好感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, tóngshì bǎ tā de shǔtiáo fēn yí bàn gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
examples.english: I was very hungry, and my colleague shared half of his fries with me, which really moved me.

examples.chinese: 我在車站遇到以前的同事，他現在是一家保險公司的經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn yùdào yǐqián de tóngshì, tā xiànzài shì yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: I ran into a former colleague at the station; he is now a manager at an insurance company.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?
examples.english: If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
examples.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

examples.chinese: 小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng de gèxìng bǐjiào lǎn, hěn shǎo zhǔdòng bāng tóngshì de máng.
examples.english: Little Zhang's personality is rather lazy; he rarely takes the initiative to help his colleagues.

examples.chinese: 同事搬新家，我們送他一組茶具，恭喜他吧。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì bān xīn jiā, wǒmen sòng tā yī zǔ chájù, gōngxǐ tā ba.
examples.english: A colleague is moving to a new home; let's give him a tea set to congratulate him.

examples.chinese: 公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǔcān shíjiān hěn duǎn, yīncǐ tóngshìmen zǒngshì chī de hěn gǎn.
examples.english: The company's lunch break is very short, so colleagues always eat in a hurry.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 我的同事遲到的次數太多了，這個月被扣了半個月的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì chídào de cìshù tài duō le, zhè ge yuè bèi kòu le bàn ge yuè de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: My colleague has been late too many times; this month half a month's salary was deducted.

examples.chinese: 公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī shàngtóu yāoqiú Xiǎo Zhāng yī gè rén wánchéng rènwu, tóngshìmen dōu rènwéi yǒudiǎnr miǎnqiǎng.
examples.english: The company higher-ups asked Xiao Zhang to complete the task alone; his colleagues all thought it was a bit of a stretch.

examples.chinese: 我同事下個月總算要和交往十年的女朋友結婚了，真是不容易啊！。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì xià ge yuè zǒngsuàn yào hé jiāowǎng shí nián de nǚpéngyǒu jiéhūn le, zhēn shì bù róngyì a!
examples.english: My colleague is finally going to marry his girlfriend of ten years next month—it really wasn't easy!

examples.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
examples.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

examples.chinese: 公司來了位新同事，老闆要我向他一一介紹公司的規定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lái le wèi xīn tóngshì, lǎobǎn yào wǒ xiàng tā yīyī jièshào gōngsī de guīdìng.
examples.english: A new colleague came to the company, and the boss asked me to introduce the company's rules to him one by one.

examples.chinese: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì gōngsī zhǔbàn de, mùdì shì wèile zēngjiā tóngshì zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
examples.english: This event is organized by the company, and the purpose is to increase the bonds among colleagues.

items.wordHook: 同(same) + 事(affair) → people who share the same work affairs: colleague.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，我認識了很多國家的新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ rènshi le hěn duō guójiā de xīn péngyǒu.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have met many new friends from many countries.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 他年輕時曾經去過很多國家旅遊，現在老了，沒體力出國了。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí céngjīng qùguo hěn duō guójiā lǚyóu, xiànzài lǎo le, méi tǐlì chūguó le.
examples.english: When he was young, he once traveled to many countries; now he is old and doesn't have the energy to go abroad.

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 在德國舉辦的歐洲足球比賽，一共有十二個國家報名。
examples.pinyin: Zài Déguó jǔbàn de Ōuzhōu zúqiú bǐsài, yígòng yǒu shí'èr ge guójiā bàomíng.
examples.english: For the European football match held in Germany, a total of twelve countries registered.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 臺灣是一個海島國家，周圍的海底有豐富的珍貴資源。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yī gè hǎidǎo guójiā, zhōuwéi de hǎidǐ yǒu fēngfù de zhēnguì zīyuán.
examples.english: Taiwan is an island country; the seabed around it has rich and precious resources.

examples.chinese: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.
examples.english: The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 「總統」是國家最高領導人，他領導全國民眾往前走，讓國家越來越進步。
examples.pinyin: 「Zǒngtǒng」 shì guójiā zuìgāo lǐngdǎorén, tā lǐngdǎo quánguó mínzhòng wǎng qián zǒu, ràng guójiā yuè lái yuè jìnbù.
examples.english: The "president" is the highest leader of the country; he leads the people of the whole nation forward, making the country more and more progressive.

examples.chinese: 總統對國家的貢獻很大，全國民眾都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng duì guójiā de gòngxiàn hěn dà, quánguó mínzhòng dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: The president's contribution to the country is great; the people of the whole nation all respect him.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.
examples.english: Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued.

examples.chinese: 每個國家打招呼的方式都不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè guójiā dǎ zhāohū de fāngshì dōu bù tài yīyàng.
examples.english: The ways of greeting in every country are not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 發展科技對國家來說很重要，不過也應該注意環保問題。
examples.pinyin: Fāzhǎn kējì duì guójiā lái shuō hěn zhòngyào, bùguò yě yīnggāi zhùyì huánbǎo wèntí.
examples.english: Developing technology is very important for a country, but attention should also be paid to environmental protection issues.

examples.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

examples.chinese: 送禮品給外國朋友前，最好先了解不同國家的送禮習慣。
examples.pinyin: Sòng lǐpǐn gěi wàiguó péngyǒu qián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě bùtóng guójiā de sònglǐ xíguàn.
examples.english: Before giving gifts to foreign friends, it's best to first understand the gift-giving customs of different countries.

examples.chinese: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā chūkǒu de nóngchǎnpǐn hěn yǒumíng, bùdàn jiàgé dī, pǐnzhì yòu hǎo.
examples.english: The agricultural products our country exports are very famous; not only is the price low, but the quality is also good.

examples.chinese: 部分國家規定，騎腳踏車時是不能載人的。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn guójiā guīdìng, qí jiǎotàchē shí shì bù néng zài rén de.
examples.english: Some countries stipulate that when riding a bicycle, you cannot carry passengers.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā wèi le xīyǐn gèng duō de guānguāngkè lái lǚyóu, jiù bǎ yìxiē chūjìng, rùjìng de shǒuxù gǎi jiǎndān le.
examples.english: Some countries, in order to attract more tourists to travel, have simplified some exit and entry procedures.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú shīqù le rénmín de xìnxīn yǔ zhīchí, guójiā yě huì biàn de bù āndìng.
examples.english: If it loses the people's confidence and support, the country will also become unstable.

examples.chinese: 有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā jīchǎng duì xiédài wùpǐn de guīdìng hěn yán, chūguó qián zuìhǎo liǎojiě qīngchu.
examples.english: Some countries' airports have very strict regulations on carried items; before going abroad, it's best to understand them clearly.

examples.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
examples.pinyin: A: Nà suǒ dàxué suīrán xiāngdāng zhùmíng, dàn wǒguó zhèngfǔ bù chéngrèn tāmen de xuéwèi. B: Xǔduō guójiā dōu chéngrèn nà suǒ dàxué de xuéwèi, guìguó nǎlǐ yǒu bù chéngrèn de dàolǐ?
examples.english: A: Although that university is quite famous, our government does not recognize their academic degrees. B: Many countries recognize that university's degrees—how could your esteemed country have any reason not to recognize them?

examples.chinese: 對人民來說，最大的不幸就是國家機構腐敗。
examples.pinyin: Duì rénmín lái shuō, zuìdà de bùxìng jiùshì guójiā jīgòu fǔbài.
examples.english: For the people, the greatest misfortune is corruption in national institutions.

examples.chinese: 就算沒有很高的學位，只要用心一樣能對國家社會有貢獻。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn méiyǒu hěn gāo de xuéwèi, zhǐyào yòngxīn yīyàng néng duì guójiā shèhuì yǒu gòngxiàn.
examples.english: Even without a high academic degree, as long as you are dedicated, you can still contribute to the country and society.

examples.chinese: 臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān qǐyè dào fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā shèlì gōngchǎng, shì yīnwèi dāngdì de réngōng piányi.
examples.english: Taiwanese enterprises set up factories in developing countries because local labor is cheap.

examples.chinese: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu guójiā, zhǐyào rénmín juéde bù hélǐ, dōu néng gēn xiāngguān bùmén kàngyì.
examples.english: In a free country, as long as people feel something is unreasonable, they can protest to the relevant departments.

examples.chinese: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì guójiā de gēnběn, néng gǎibiàn guójiā de wèilái.
examples.english: Education is the foundation of a country; it can change the country's future.

examples.chinese: 每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
examples.pinyin: Měi miàn guóqí dōu dàibiǎo yī ge guójiā, érqiě shèjì shàng dōu jùyǒu dútè de yìyì.
examples.english: Every national flag represents a country, and each has a unique meaning in its design.

examples.chinese: 戰爭雖然勝利了，這個國家卻也失去了許多寶貴的生命。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng suīrán shènglì le, zhè ge guójiā què yě shīqù le xǔduō bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
examples.english: Although the war was won, this country also lost many precious lives.

examples.chinese: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí jìnrù Àoyùn huìchǎng, mínzhòng yě búduàn huī zhe shǒu shàng de xiǎo qízi, tì zìjǐ de guójiā jiāyóu.
examples.english: Seeing their country's national flag enter the Olympic venue, the public also continuously waved the small flags in their hands to cheer for their country.

examples.chinese: 這項新發明解決了許多環保問題，發明的人還受國家表揚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn fāmíng jiějué le xǔduō huánbǎo wèntí, fāmíng de rén hái shòu guójiā biǎoyáng.
examples.english: This new invention solved many environmental problems, and the inventor was even praised by the country.

items.wordHook: 國(country) + 家(home) → a nation is a country that feels like home.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 很多外國學生弄不清楚漢字的聲調。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō wàiguó xuéshēng nòng bù qīngchǔ Hànzì de shēngdiào.
examples.english: Many foreign students cannot get the tones of Chinese characters clear.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 這所學校規定學生每兩週至少參加一次服務學習活動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng měi liǎng zhōu zhìshǎo cānjiā yí cì fúwù xuéxí huódòng.
examples.english: This school requires students to participate in at least one service-learning activity every two weeks.

examples.chinese: 如果想捐頭髮，長度至少要十五公分以上才能捐。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng juān tóufa, chángdù zhìshǎo yào shíwǔ gōngfēn yǐshàng cái néng juān.
examples.english: If you want to donate hair, the length must be at least fifteen centimeters or more to be able to donate.

items.wordHook: Combining 至(reach) and 少(few): 至少 means at least.

examples.chinese: 他有一點兒膽小，又容易緊張，我看這件事你先別告訴他。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yìdiǎnr dǎnxiǎo, yòu róngyì jǐnzhāng, wǒ kàn zhè jiàn shì nǐ xiān bié gàosu tā.
examples.english: He is a bit timid and also easily gets nervous; I think you'd better not tell him about this matter yet.

examples.chinese: 張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě hěn dǎnxiǎo, kàn dào chēhuò xiànchǎng yǒu rén liú le hěn duō xiě, dāngchǎng jiù hūndǎo le.
examples.english: Miss Zhang is very timid; when she saw someone bleeding a lot at the car accident scene, she fainted on the spot.

examples.chinese: 我姑姑跟姑丈結婚已經有二十年了，感情一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu gēn gūzhàng jiéhūn yǐjīng yǒu èrshí nián le, gǎnqíng yīzhí hěn hǎo.
examples.english: My paternal aunt and her husband (my uncle) have been married for twenty years already, and their relationship has always been very good.

examples.chinese: 我姑姑的房間裡有淡淡的玫瑰花味兒，那種氣味真香。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu de fángjiān lǐ yǒu dàndàn de méiguīhuā wèir, nà zhǒng qìwèi zhēn xiāng.
examples.english: There is a faint rose scent in my aunt's room; that smell is really fragrant.

examples.chinese: 到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
examples.pinyin: Dào wàimiàn zuò le diūrén de shì, zìjǐ hé jiārén yě huì juéde diūliǎn.
examples.english: If you go out and do something shameful, you and your family will also feel disgraced.

examples.chinese: 他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shùnlì dāngshàng nà jiā dà fàndiàn de chúshī hòu, hǎoduō péngyǒu dōu dǎ diànhuà zhùhè tā.
examples.english: After he successfully became a chef at that big hotel, many friends called to congratulate him.

examples.chinese: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu zhǎodào lǐxiǎng gōngzuò hòu, nǚyǒu tèdì sòng le yī tiáo lǐngdài dāngzuò lǐwù, hái qīnshǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐngdài, zhùhè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāishǐ.
examples.english: After Xiao Zhou found his ideal job, his girlfriend specially gave him a necktie as a gift, and even personally tied the necktie for him, congratulating him on a good start.

examples.chinese: 這塊玉的品質不錯，如果做成玉器應該可以賣出好價錢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài yù de pǐnzhì bùcuò, rúguǒ zuòchéng yùqì yīnggāi kěyǐ mài chū hǎo jiàqián.
examples.english: The quality of this piece of jade is quite good; if it is made into jade ware, it should be able to sell for a good price.

examples.chinese: 雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
examples.pinyin: Diāokè yùqì de jìshù hěn fùzá, mùqián duōbàn háishì zhǐ néng kào réngōng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: The technique of carving jade is very complex; at present, most of it can still only be handled by hand.

examples.chinese: 奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai yǎngle jǐ zhī jī, měitiān zǎoshang xíguàn zhuā liǎng bǎ yùmǐ wèi tāmen.
examples.english: Grandma raises several chickens, and every morning she is used to grabbing two handfuls of corn to feed them.

examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

items.wordHook: The royal 王(king) scepter set with a gleaming 丶(dot) at its base is crafted from precious 玉(jade).
Combining 以(according to) and 外(out): 以外 means apart from, except for.
a 亻(person) stands with 更(more) time to spare → oh so 便(convenient).
最(most) + 近(near) → the most near time is 'recently'.
Combining 博(wide) and 士(scholar): 博士 means doctor, PhD.
a 宀(roof) covers a 佰(hundred) beds for travelers → a place to 宿(stop).
Asking 怎(how) with particle 麼(particle) in this 一(one) turn 回(return) of the 事(affair): 怎麼一回事 means what's the matter.
Combining 文(culture) and 學(learn): 文學 means literature.
紅(red) + 茶(tea) → red tea, the Chinese name for black tea, from its red-colored brew.
